acquisition method: analyzed by Q-Exactive HF (Thermo Scientific) with one MS scan and up to 20 data-dependent high-resolution MS/MS scans
cleavage agent: Searches were performed using 15 ppm mass tolerance and allowing up to two missed trypsin cleavage sites
fractionation method: The TMT-labeled peptides were pooled and separated into six fractions by an Ultra-micro spin C18 column
instrument: analyzed by Q-Exactive HF (Thermo Scientific) with one MS scan
labeling: The proteins were then in-gel digested and labeled with 11 different tandem mass tags (TMT; Thermo Scientific)
